name: Blackfathom Deeps
summary: Twilight's Hammer cultists now gather in the flooded halls of Blackfathom Deeps, along the Zoram Strand in northwestern Ashenvale. The temple once honored Elune, the night elven moon goddess. Naga and satyrs have joined the cult in veneration of Aku'mai, a primordial hydra and servant of an Old God.

sections.title: Sunken Sanctum of Elune
sections.body: Blackfathom Deeps once honored Elune, the night elven moon goddess. Long before the Great Sundering shattered ancient Kalimdor, Highborne masons raised gem-encrusted bridges through its splendid halls. Queen Azshara commanded the waters around the sacred moonwell, keeping salt seas and mountain streams apart. When the Sundering broke the world ten thousand years ago, the temple sank beneath the coastal waters of the Veiled Sea. It lay undisturbed for millennia, until foul whispers began to rise from the darkness below.

sections.title: A Den of Ancient Horrors
sections.body: Twilight's Hammer cultists came to the sunken ruins, drawn by mad dreams and dark portents. Inside, they forged an unholy truce with coastal naga led by Lady Sarevess and prowling satyrs. Together, they desecrated the moonwell and enslaved the creatures nearby. Years of torment drove the giant sea turtle Ghamoo-ra mad. The brutal murloc Gelihast raised a blood shrine, and the caverns filled with fresh sacrifices. Under Twilight Lord Kelris, the cultists made the ruins a staging ground for the Old Gods' impending return.

sections.title: The Beast in the Deep
sections.body: Aku'mai dwells in the deepest heart of the sunken temple. The ancient three-headed hydra serves an Old God and rose from the waters after its corruption tainted the temple's Moon Well. Twilight Lord Kelris and his cultists sacrifice innocents to Aku'mai for power. Striking down Kelris and lighting the ritual candles in his sanctum opens the way to the beast's lair, where champions can slay Aku'mai before its evil spreads across Kalimdor.

faq.q: What was Blackfathom Deeps before it fell into darkness?
faq.answer: Blackfathom Deeps began as a magnificent night elven temple devoted to Elune, the moon goddess. Crystal-clear pools, gemmed bridges, and a blessed moonwell filled its halls, under Queen Azshara's watch, until the Great Sundering broke the temple and sank it beneath the sea.

faq.q: Why are the Twilight's Hammer cultists here?
faq.answer: Nightmare visions and whispering voices from beneath Azeroth drew the cultists to worship the Old Gods. Under Twilight Lord Kelris, they seized the sunken ruins and nurture Aku'mai with living sacrifices, hoping to hasten their chaotic masters' return.
Twilight Lord Kelris leads the Twilight's Hammer cell in Blackfathom Deeps. He seeks the return of the Old Gods, directs the cult's sacrifices to Aku'mai, and oversees the temple's desecration.

faq.q: What are the naga and satyr doing in the ruins?
faq.answer: Naga and satyrs were drawn to the drowned temple by lingering ancient magical energies. Led by Lady Sarevess, the naga made a pact with the Twilight's Hammer: the cultists provide captives and dark knowledge, while her sea witches shield them from horrors in the deep.

faq.q: Why do the Earthen Ring and Argent Dawn care about this place?
faq.answer: The Argent Dawn sent Scout Thaelrid to investigate suspected alliances between the naga and cultists, and he uncovered proof of their murderous rituals. The Earthen Ring rushed to Ashenvale because invoking the Old Gods threatens elemental balance and the world's safety.

faq.q: What happens when Aku'mai is defeated?
aliases: what happens when you kill aku'mai
faq.answer: Slaying Aku'mai cuts off the Old Gods' immediate physical foothold in Ashenvale. It ends the cult's hope of restoring their reign through the ancient hydra, deals a major blow to the Twilight's Hammer, and cleanses part of the dark taint infecting the ruined moonwell.

angles.text: As a night elf, you see a beloved part of your heritage desecrated: an ancient shrine of Elune and its sacred moonwell befouled by void cultists and monstrous aberrations.
As a shaman answering Je'neu and the Earthen Ring, you must plunge into the watery dark to halt the corruption of the elements and banish the Old Gods' chaotic taint.
From Zoram'gar Outpost, the Horde seeks to secure Ashenvale's northern coast against naga aggression and keep the dark rituals from threatening its outposts.
As an Alliance hero, you enter to rescue Scout Thaelrid, recover lost Highborne knowledge, and help the night elves cleanse their sacred homeland of cultist terror.
